competency.title: Derive convolutions — field data
competency.outcome: Derive a formal or quantitative account of convolutions using a translation-sensitive feature extractor. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.

topic_kernel.measure: accuracy under translations and parameter count

competency.practice_task: Produce a stepwise derivation with units or invariants grounded in a translation-sensitive feature extractor.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.
required_evidence: a stepwise derivation with units or invariants
Include the data card, missingness check and permitted use.
Report accuracy under translations and parameter count with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: assuming convolution yields full invariance.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of convolutions.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report accuracy under translations and parameter count against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for assuming convolution yields full invariance; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
